description: 将 .claude 工作流转换为 Qoder 可识别的 AGENTS.md、.qoder/rules、.qoder/commands，并通过 Quest Code with Spec 保留先审阅后执行的自动化边界。

userStories.title: 创建 Qoder 兼容的项目级 AGENTS.md
userStories.description: 作为 AI 工作流维护者，我想让 Qoder 打开项目时自动理解这个仓库的定位和安全规则，以便后续 agent 不需要重新发现上下文。
acceptanceCriteria: 项目根目录存在 AGENTS.md
AGENTS.md 明确说明本仓库是 AI coding workflow / agent harness 模板库，不是业务应用源码仓
AGENTS.md 包含 .agents、.claude、.cursor、.qoder、scripts/ralph 的用途说明
AGENTS.md 包含默认中文沟通、技术名词保留英文、不确定需说明验证方法的规则
AGENTS.md 包含禁止无授权 commit、push、publish、批量删除、覆盖重要文件的约束
Command `test -s AGENTS.md && rg -n "Qoder|Ralph|source-command|禁止" AGENTS.md` returns matches
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 创建 Qoder 安全与沟通规则
userStories.description: 作为 AI 工具研究者，我想把长期安全约束沉淀到 .qoder/rules，以便 Qoder 在任何任务中都默认遵守这些边界。
acceptanceCriteria: .qoder/rules/always-project-safety.md exists and is non-empty
Rule content includes Chinese-first communication, direct practical answers, no false certainty, and verification paths when uncertain
Rule content requires dry-run, backup, validation, or rollback path before high-risk operations
Rule content forbids script-based bulk deletion of files or directories
Rule content forbids automatic publish, send, upload, commit, push, or overwrite of important content without explicit authorization
Command `test -s .qoder/rules/always-project-safety.md && wc -m .qoder/rules/always-project-safety.md` succeeds
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 创建 Qoder Quest 工作流规则
userStories.description: 作为需要使用 Qoder Quest 的用户，我想让 Quest 默认采用 Spec-first 流程，以便先审需求和验收标准，再允许实现。
acceptanceCriteria: .qoder/rules/qoder-quest-workflow.md exists and is non-empty
Rule content requires feature tasks to prefer Quest Code with Spec
Rule content requires user review before Run Spec
Rule content explains that narrow changes can use Agent mode and complex multi-system tasks can use Experts mode
Rule content does not claim the Quest mode can be switched freely in the middle of a task
Rule content requires Quest output to preserve validation commands, risks, and rollback path
Command `rg -n "Code with Spec|Spec|Agent mode|Experts mode|Run Spec" .qoder/rules/qoder-quest-workflow.md` returns matches
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 创建 Ralph one-story 兼容规则
userStories.description: 作为维护 Ralph 自动化流程的人，我想让 Qoder 理解 Ralph 每次只处理一个 story 的执行边界，以便避免一次性改太多或误启动自治循环。
acceptanceCriteria: .qoder/rules/ralph-one-story.md exists and is non-empty
Rule content requires Ralph-like tasks to read scripts/ralph/prd.json and scripts/ralph/progress.txt first
Rule content requires each run to handle only one highest-priority story with passes=false and blocked=false
Rule content requires updating story state and appending progress.txt instead of replacing progress history
Rule content requires stopping and reporting a blocker if real prd.json or progress.txt is missing
Command `rg -n "one story|prd.json|progress.txt|passes|blocked" .qoder/rules/ralph-one-story.md` returns matches
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 创建 Qoder /prime 项目命令
userStories.description: 作为使用 Qoder 的开发者，我想通过 /prime 快速建立项目理解，以便开始任何任务前先知道当前仓库结构和关键文件。
acceptanceCriteria: .qoder/commands/prime.md exists and is non-empty
The command frontmatter includes name: prime and description
The command body requires checking project structure, core docs, key files, and current state before edits
The command body includes a non-git fallback using rg --files or find when git ls-files or git status is unavailable
Command `ruby -e 's=File.read(".qoder/commands/prime.md"); abort unless s.start_with?("---\n") && s.include?("name: prime") && s.include?("description:")'` succeeds
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 创建 Qoder /create-rules 项目命令
userStories.description: 作为维护多工具 prompt 资产的人，我想通过 /create-rules 从项目结构生成或更新规则，以便持续让 Qoder 与仓库真实状态对齐。
acceptanceCriteria: .qoder/commands/create-rules.md exists and is non-empty
The command frontmatter includes name: create-rules and description
The command body requires identifying project type, tech stack, directory structure, key files, and validation commands
The command body explains that AGENTS.md holds general project memory and .qoder/rules holds Qoder-specific behavior
The command body requires reading and merging an existing AGENTS.md instead of overwriting it
Command `ruby -e 's=File.read(".qoder/commands/create-rules.md"); abort unless s.include?("name: create-rules") && s.include?(".qoder/rules") && s.include?("AGENTS.md")'` succeeds
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 创建 Qoder /plan-feature 项目命令
userStories.description: 作为 AI workflow 实践者，我想在 Qoder 中复用现有 /plan-feature 规划流程，以便功能实现前先产出可执行计划。
acceptanceCriteria: .qoder/commands/plan-feature.md exists and is non-empty
The command frontmatter includes name: plan-feature and description
The command body clearly states planning-only behavior and forbids product-code implementation unless separately authorized later
The command body requires writing output to .agents/plans/{kebab-case-feature-name}.md
The command body includes problem, user value, context files, external docs, phased tasks, validation commands, risks, and rollback path
Command `ruby -e 's=File.read(".qoder/commands/plan-feature.md"); abort unless s.include?("name: plan-feature") && s.include?(".agents/plans") && s.match?(/do not|不得|不要/)'` succeeds
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 创建 Qoder Quest 生成 .qoder 文件的命令
userStories.description: 作为希望让 Qoder 自己落地配置的人，我想有一个专门命令把当前 PRD 和 plan 交给 Quest，以便 Quest 先产出 Spec，再实现 .qoder 文件。
acceptanceCriteria: .qoder/commands/quest-generate-qoder-files.md exists and is non-empty
The command frontmatter includes name: quest-generate-qoder-files and description
The command body requires Qoder Quest to use Code with Spec
The command body requires reading tasks/prd-qoder-quest-automation-files.md and .agents/plans/qoder-quest-automation-files.md first
The command body requires generating a Spec and waiting for user review before Run Spec
The command body forbids commit, push, publish, bulk deletion, and overwriting .claude, .agents, .cursor, or scripts/ralph

Command `ruby -e 's=File.read(".qoder/commands/quest-generate-qoder-files.md"); abort unless s.include?("name: quest-generate-qoder-files") && s.include?("Code with Spec") && s.match?(/review|审阅/)'` succeeds
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 验证 Qoder 项目命令与规则可被识别
userStories.description: 作为最终使用者，我想确认 Qoder 能在当前项目里看到新 commands 和 rules，以便知道这些文件不是只存在于磁盘上。
acceptanceCriteria: Command `find .qoder -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort` lists .qoder/rules/*.md and .qoder/commands/*.md files
Command `rg -n "^name:|^description:" .qoder/commands/*.md` shows frontmatter for all four commands

Command `ruby -e 'Dir[".qoder/commands/*.md"].each { |f| s=File.read(f); abort("#{f}: missing frontmatter") unless s.start_with?("---
") && s.include?("
---
") && s[/^name: /] && s[/^description: /] }'` succeeds
In Qoder opened at /Volumes/WorkSSD/Dev/自动化AI+coding+2.1, typing / in the Agent dialog shows prime, create-rules, plan-feature, and quest-generate-qoder-files
If qodercli is installed and authenticated, any smoke command is run only after confirming it will not perform writes or consume large quota; otherwise manual verification is recorded
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Quest 端到端闭环验证
userStories.description: 作为用户，我想确认 Qoder Quest 会先生成 Spec 并等待审阅，而不是直接修改 .qoder 文件，以便保留人工决策权。
acceptanceCriteria: In Qoder Quest, select Code with Spec before starting the verification task
Enter /quest-generate-qoder-files or paste that command body
Quest reads the PRD and plan and produces a reviewable Spec
The Spec lists AGENTS.md, .qoder/rules/*.md, and .qoder/commands/*.md as the files to create or update
Before the user clicks Run Spec, no .qoder implementation files are newly created or modified
If the user rejects or closes the Spec, the .qoder directory remains unchanged
After explicit user confirmation and Run Spec, Quest creates only PRD-allowed files and does not modify existing .claude, .agents, .cursor, or scripts/ralph files
Typecheck passes
